brief:
Former US President Donald Trump is set to return to the UN General Assembly, Al Jazeera English reported. His appearance comes as tensions with Iran escalate and Israeli military operations in Gaza continue despite a ceasefire agreement. The visit is expected to draw scrutiny over American foreign policy objectives in the Middle East.

Trump's speech will take place against a backdrop of active regional conflict and international criticism of US-backed Israeli actions. Questions remain over what policy positions the former president will articulate on Iran and Palestinian matters.
dek: Trump returns to UNGA amid Iran war he started, Israeli violations of a Gaza ceasefire, and scrutiny of US aims.
title: Trump to address UN amid Iran tensions and Gaza ceasefire violations
